parts.title: Connect-4 Game Engine
parts.description: Board representation, move mechanics, terminal detection, and the env step function.

parts.title: Board Encoding and Policy-Value Network
parts.description: Encode boards as tensors and a conv backbone with policy and value heads.

parts.title: Action Masking and Policy Sampling
parts.description: Mask illegal moves and turn logits into sampled or greedy column actions.

parts.title: PUCT Monte Carlo Tree Search
parts.description: Nodes, PUCT selection, network-guided expansion, backup, and full MCTS rollouts.

parts.title: Self-Play Data Generation
parts.description: MCTS self-play recording (state, policy, outcome) training tuples.

parts.title: Losses and Training Loop
parts.description: Policy, value, and L2 losses and minibatched training over the self-play buffer.

parts.title: Iterated Training Loop
parts.description: Alternate self-play generation and network training across iterations.

parts.title: Agents and Evaluation
parts.description: Baseline agents, head-to-head matches, and win rate against a random policy.

steps.name: make_empty_board
steps.doc: A fresh 6x7 board of zeros.

steps.name: column_top_row
steps.doc: Row index a dropped piece would land in (lowest empty row), or -1 if full.

steps.name: column_full
steps.doc: True if a column has no empty cell.

steps.name: valid_moves
steps.doc: List of columns that are not full.

steps.name: drop_piece
steps.doc: Return a NEW board with ``player``'s piece dropped into ``col``.

steps.name: four_in_a_row_horizontal
steps.doc: True if ``player`` has four consecutive pieces in any row.

steps.name: four_in_a_row_vertical
steps.doc: True if ``player`` has four consecutive pieces in any column.

steps.name: four_in_a_row_diagonal_down_right
steps.doc: True if ``player`` has four in a row along a down-right (\) diagonal.

steps.name: four_in_a_row_diagonal_up_right
steps.doc: True if ``player`` has four in a row along an up-right (/) diagonal.

steps.name: check_winner
steps.doc: Return the winning player (+1 / -1), or 0 if there is no winner.

steps.name: board_is_full
steps.doc: True if there are no empty cells.

steps.name: is_terminal
steps.doc: True if the game is over (someone won or the board is full).

steps.name: other_player
steps.doc: The opponent of ``player``.

steps.name: step_env
steps.doc:
Apply ``player``'s move in ``col``. Returns (next_board, reward, done) where
reward is +1 if this move wins for ``player``, else 0.

steps.name: encode_board
steps.doc:
Two planes from ``player``'s perspective: [my pieces, opponent pieces].
Shape (2, 6, 7), float.

steps.name: board_to_torch_tensor
steps.doc: Turn an encoded board into a batched float tensor (1, C, 6, 7).

steps.name: init_conv_backbone
steps.doc: A small conv backbone preserving the 6x7 spatial size.

steps.name: init_policy_head
steps.doc: Linear policy head over the flattened features -> action logits.

steps.name: init_value_head
steps.doc: Value head -> a scalar in [-1, 1] via tanh.

steps.name: build_policy_value_net
steps.doc:
Assemble the conv backbone + policy and value heads into one module whose
forward(x) returns (policy_logits (B, n_actions), value (B,)).

steps.name: policy_value_forward
steps.doc: Run the network: returns (policy_logits, value).

steps.name: action_mask
steps.doc: A length-7 float mask: 1 for legal (non-full) columns, 0 otherwise.

steps.name: masked_policy_logits
steps.doc: Set logits of illegal actions (mask==0) to -inf.

steps.name: masked_log_softmax
steps.doc: Log-softmax over legal actions only (illegal -> -inf).

steps.name: sample_action_from_policy
steps.doc: Sample a legal column from softmax(masked logits).

steps.name: greedy_action_from_policy
steps.doc: The legal column with the highest logit.

steps.name: make_mcts_node
steps.doc:
An MCTS node for a state: the board, the player to move, the prior prob of
reaching it, visit count N, value sum W, children, and an expanded flag.

steps.name: node_q_value
steps.doc: Mean value of a node from its own player's perspective (0 if unvisited).

steps.name: ucb_score
steps.doc:
PUCT score of a child from the PARENT's perspective: -Q(child) (the child's
value is from the opponent's view) + c_puct * P * sqrt(N_parent) / (1 + N_child).

steps.name: select_best_child
steps.doc: The (action, child) with the highest PUCT score.

steps.name: select_leaf
steps.doc: Walk down via PUCT until an unexpanded or terminal node. Returns (leaf, path).

steps.name: evaluate_with_network
steps.doc:
Network evaluation of a position: (priors over 7 columns, value in [-1,1]),
from ``player``'s perspective. Illegal columns get prior 0.

steps.name: expand_node
steps.doc: Create a child for every legal move, carrying its prior. Marks node expanded.

steps.name: backup_value
steps.doc:
Propagate ``value`` (from the leaf player's perspective) up the path, flipping
sign at each level since players alternate.

steps.name: run_one_simulation
steps.doc:
One MCTS simulation: select a leaf, evaluate/expand (or use the game result if
terminal), and back the value up.

steps.name: run_mcts
steps.doc: Run ``n_simulations`` simulations from ``root`` and return it.

steps.name: visit_count_policy
steps.doc:
Policy over 7 columns from child visit counts, sharpened by ``temperature``
(temperature 0 -> one-hot on the most-visited action).

steps.name: mcts_choose_action
steps.doc: Pick a column: argmax visits at temperature 0, else sample the visit policy.

steps.name: record_self_play_step
steps.doc:
Append a (state, MCTS policy, player) tuple; the value target is filled in
later from the game outcome. Returns the buffer.

steps.name: play_self_play_game
steps.doc:
Play one MCTS self-play game. Returns (records, winner) where records are
(encoded_state, mcts_policy, player) tuples.

steps.name: assign_value_targets
steps.doc:
Turn (state, policy, player) records into (state, policy, value) where value is
+1 if that player won, -1 if they lost, 0 for a draw.

steps.name: generate_self_play_batch
steps.signature: generate_self_play_batch(net, n_games, n_simulations, c_puct, temperature, rng)
steps.doc: Play ``n_games`` self-play games and return all (state, policy, value) tuples.

steps.name: value_loss_mse
steps.doc: Mean squared error between predicted and target values.

steps.name: policy_loss_cross_entropy
steps.doc: Cross-entropy between the network policy and the MCTS target distribution.

steps.name: l2_regularization_loss
steps.doc: L2 penalty on all parameters.

steps.name: combined_loss
steps.doc: AlphaZero loss: value MSE + policy cross-entropy + L2.

steps.name: encode_batch_states
steps.doc: Stack a list of encoded (2,6,7) states into a (B,2,6,7) float tensor.

steps.name: iterate_minibatches
steps.doc: Split ``data`` into minibatches (optionally shuffled). Returns a list of batches.

steps.name: training_step
steps.doc: One training step over a list of (state, policy, value) tuples. Returns loss.

steps.name: training_epoch
steps.signature: training_epoch(net, data, optimizer, batch_size, weight_decay, generator=None)
steps.doc: One pass over ``data`` in minibatches. Returns the mean loss.

steps.name: self_play_iteration
steps.signature: self_play_iteration(net, optimizer, n_games, n_simulations, c_puct, temperature, batch_size, weight_decay, rng)
steps.doc:
One AlphaZero iteration: generate self-play data, then train one epoch on it.
Returns (mean_loss, data).

steps.name: train_loop
steps.signature: train_loop(net, optimizer, n_iterations, n_games, n_simulations, c_puct, temperature, batch_size, weight_decay, rng)
steps.doc: Alternate self-play and training for ``n_iterations``. Returns (net, losses).

steps.name: random_policy_action
steps.doc: A random legal column.

steps.name: greedy_agent_action
steps.doc: Greedy column from the network's policy (no search).

steps.name: play_one_match
steps.doc:
Play a game: agent_a is player +1, agent_b is player -1. Each agent is a
callable(board, player) -> action. Returns the winner (+1/-1/0).

steps.name: match_win_rate
steps.doc: Fraction of games won by ``perspective`` (+1/-1).

steps.name: evaluate_against_random
steps.doc: Greedy network agent (as +1) vs a random opponent; return its win rate.
